issues.description: play.ts ships a debugging scratchpad with relative imports and console.log residue
issues.detail: The diff converts play.ts from a canonical `zod/v4` import into a relative path into packages/zod/src plus console.log debugging. This is a maintainer's local scribble, not a feature change. Drop or revert play.ts before merge.

issues.description: Override semantics silently changed; overrideCount jumped 6 to 12 without justification
issues.detail: The previous `if (!seen.isParent) ctx.override(...)` guard was removed, so override now fires unconditionally. The test literally named "do not run on references" was updated from 6 to 12 calls to make it pass. This is a user-visible behavior change for override callbacks and must be justified or reverted, not snapshot-updated.

issues.description: JSON.stringify-based dedup is the wrong data structure and quadratic on large schemas
issues.detail: finalize() compares schema values via `JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b)` in two places inside a key loop. This is order-dependent, silently wrong when keys serialize differently, and O(N*size) on nested trees. Replace with structural equality or fingerprint the def once.

issues.description: flattenRef recursion via seen.parent has no termination guard analogous to seen.ref=null
issues.detail: The ref branch nulls seen.ref to prevent re-entry, but the new seen.parent branch calls flattenRef(seen.parent) with no equivalent sentinel. Termination depends on call order and the parent's own ref already being nulled. State the well-founded invariant or add an explicit visited check.

issues.description: Seen carries overlapping ref/parent fields with precedence rules that live only in comments
issues.detail: Seen gained a parent field alongside ref, and finalize() juggles three cases: ref===parent, ref!==parent, and ref===null. The data shape no longer makes the algorithm obvious. Collapse to one field with an explicit kind, or document the invariant at the type level.

issues.description: Commit bundles three independent changes that should be three patches
issues.detail: The diff combines (a) parent/ref tracking rework in process/finalize, (b) fileProcessor anyOf hoisting (a user-visible JSON Schema output change), and (c) the mini ZodType `{parent: true}` flip. Each is independently reviewable and revertable. Split before landing.

synthesis.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The core intent — tracking parent (clone chain) separately from processor-set ref so $ref propagation survives wrappers like readonly().meta().describe() — is reasonable and the fileProcessor anyOf factoring is a clean win. But the patch ships a debugging scratchpad (play.ts), silently doubles override callback invocations against a test named "do not run on references", introduces JSON.stringify-based dedup that is both semantically wrong and quadratic, and adds a second flattenRef entry path via seen.parent with no termination guard. The Seen data shape is now overlapping fields governed by comments rather than types. Drop play.ts, justify or revert the override change, replace stringify dedup with structural equality, state the recursion invariant, and split into focused patches.
